content: Authoritative .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter (code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents): only name and description are required; optional fields are tools, disallowedTools, model (default inherit; sonnet/opus/haiku/fable/full-id/inherit), permissionMode, maxTurns, skills, mcpServers, hooks, memory, background, effort, isolation, color, initialPrompt. There is NO 'coordinator' field. Critical: the Agent(agent_type) allowlist applies ONLY to an agent running as the MAIN THREAD via claude --agent or the agent setting; inside a subagent definition the parenthesised type list is IGNORED and bare Agent simply permits nesting. Nesting depth history: v2.1.172-2.1.216 default 5 and unchangeable; v2.1.217-2.1.218 default 1 (nesting effectively OFF); v2.1.219+ default 3, tunable via CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH (1 disables). Also: 200 subagents/session (v2.1.212+), 20 concurrent (v2.1.217+). Since v2.1.198 subagents run in the BACKGROUND by default, which strips most built-in tools down to a fixed list (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash/PowerShell/Edit/Write/NotebookEdit/WebFetch/WebSearch/TodoWrite/Skill/ToolSearch/EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree/Monitor/TaskStop/SendMessage/Artifact) while keeping every MCP tool. From v2.1.208 a tools list where nothing resolves refuses to launch with a named error. Scope precedence: managed > --agents flag > .claude/agents/ > ~/.claude/agents/ > plugin agents/. Plugin subagents ignore hooks, mcpServers and permissionMode.
